question: Which orders were placed in the first quarter of 2024? Show each order's id and when it was placed.
reply:
```sql
SELECT "order_id", "placed_at"
FROM billing."order"
WHERE "placed_at" >= '2024-01-01' AND "placed_at" < '2024-04-01';
```

```sql-unbound
SELECT "order_id", "placed_at"
FROM billing."order"
WHERE "placed_at" >= :start_date AND "placed_at" < :end_date;
```
